Makumaku, was it? I don't
recognize that face, but
that's no ordinary person.

rows.label: tlk70000013_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Because Chairman Morumo got
spanked on the bottom like
a child!

rows.label: tlk70000013_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I wonder what their relationship is. I
want to know, but I don't... I'm too
afraid to ask.
